validation.note: A TTL-only candidate failed both statx(ATIME) cases. Explicit attributes-only invalidation after write and O_TRUNC fixed both.

remaining_cost: Each open/release still commits durable inode reference updates. Directory reads and Git file opens retain these synchronous costs.

limitations: three repetitions; report medians, do not interpret p95
historical_drive9.caches: profile none, ordinary data caches; kernel attribute/entry TTL 60 seconds; directory TTL 10 seconds; --trust-process-local-events enabled for this single-server run
historical_drive9.durability: explicit --durability=fsync: fsync waits for remote commit; ordinary write/close may complete before remote upload; no extra fsync in timed upstream workloads

io_regression_check.scope: Three paired repetitions, alternating order, fresh database per variant/repetition. Production live FUSE with direct_io and FULL synchronous WAL; metadata TTL baseline=0 s, optimized=60 s; hot OS cache. Agent-owned builds/tests finished before measurement; unrelated builds and services were active on the shared host. Sequential write includes flush/fsync/close. Fixture preparation and validation are untimed.
